svg.title: LoomFlow — build and review workflow
svg.desc: Seven stages. Define: refine the requirement and size the change. Build: Small and Normal builds go straight to a PR; Major builds add a design note and design review. Prepare: verify the PR and select the scan or full review. Review: scan, or two full reviewers, then validate the reports and checks. Fix: one analyzer fixes or rebuts findings and failed checks; round 2 reuses the review stage once. Gate: one merge gate. Close: every exit, including a stop, records a retrospective.
svg.text: Build a task or review a PR · refine, size, build, review, one fixer, one gate
the final round, or user critical

g.text: Ask every gap in one message.
Review mode keeps a larger size.
Builder checks and opens the PR.
Draft PR: x over y, deletions,
R2 only if a blocker is open.
Safety fact + proof in PR body.
MAJOR SERIES · MORE THAN ONE PR
Local check gates; CI runs cancelled; trail file.
Redesign series: stop after the last merge; user tests.
Scan only for small, safe diffs.
A failed check is a blocker.
One TSV row, also on a stop.

svg.text: Supervised mode (only when asked): the user approves the requirement, the plan or design note, and the start of the gate.
At most two review rounds and one merge gate. No round 3, no second gate, no restart. Commits after the last review are reported as unreviewed.
Direct agent reports control the run. PR review and analyzer comments are audit copies. Only the user starts a run.
